style:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton&family=Anton+SC&family=Bree+Serif&family=Orelega+One&family=Patua+One&family=Protest+Strike&display=swap');

  :root {
    font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;

    /*
    Set your paper size here

    Default: A4
      A4 Paper is 210mm x 297mm
      A3 Paper is 297mm x 420mm
      Letter Paper is 8.5in x 11in
    */

    /* Computed size helpers in mm */
    --paper-width: {{ paperWidth }};
    --paper-height: {{ paperHeight }};

    --stamp-container-width: 3.5in;
    --stamp-container-height: 2in;
    --stamp-inner-width: 3.5in;
    --stamp-inner-height: 2in;

    --items-per-row: 2;
    --rows-per-page: 5;

    --paper-margin-x: calc(
      (var(--paper-width) - var(--items-per-row) * var(--stamp-container-width)) /
        2
    );
    --paper-margin-y: calc(
      (
          var(--paper-height) - var(--rows-per-page) *
            var(--stamp-container-height)
        ) / 2
    );

    /* Page is the internal usable space (i.e. with margins subtracted). */
    --page-width: calc(var(--paper-width) - var(--paper-margin-x) * 2);
    --page-height: calc(var(--paper-height) - var(--paper-margin-y) * 2);
  }

  /**
   * Page Settings
   */
  @page {
    size: {{ paperSize }};
    /* HACK: Chrome sets own margins, we change these printer settings */
    margin-top: var(--paper-margin-y);
    /* See HACK above as to why this is zero. */
    margin-bottom: 0;
    margin-left: var(--paper-margin-x);
    margin-right: var(--paper-margin-x);
  }

  body {
    width: var(--page-width);
    min-height: calc(var(--page-height) + var(--paper-margin-y));
    margin: 0;
    padding-top: var(--paper-margin-y);
    /* See HACK above as to why this is zero. */
    padding-bottom: 0;
    padding-left: var(--paper-margin-x);
    padding-right: var(--paper-margin-x);
    display: flex;
    align-content: flex-start;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  @media print {
    body {
      width: var(--page-width);
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
  }

  /* -----------------------------------------------------
   * SHARED CSS
   * -------------------------------------------------- */

  .stamp-container {
    /* Allow absolute positioned elements */
    position: relative;

    /* Set this as a block element */
    display: block;

    /* Do not exceed the width and height due to padding and margins */
    box-sizing: border-box;

    /* Stamp size */
    width: var(--stamp-container-width);
    height: var(--stamp-container-height);

    /* Stop stamps from being broken in half between pages */
    break-inside: avoid;

    /* Center the stamp inside of the stamp container */
    display: grid;
    align-items: start;
    justify-items: center;
  }

  .stamp-inner {
    /* Do not exceed the width and height due to padding and margins */
    box-sizing: border-box;

    /* Set stamp size */
    width: var(--stamp-inner-width);
    height: var(--stamp-inner-height);

    /* Define layout inside of the stamp */
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-start; /* Centers horizontally */
    align-items: center; /* Centers vertically */
    
    /* Set default fonts */
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: 'Patua One', serif;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-style: normal;;
  }
  

  
  /* -----------------------------------------------------
   * FRONT CSS
   * -------------------------------------------------- */
  
  .front.stamp-inner {
    background: url({{ front.theme.background }});
    background-size: cover; /* Use 'contain' if you don't want cropping */
    background-position: center; /* Center the image within the container */
    background-repeat: no-repeat; /* Prevent repeating of the background */
    padding-top: 1mm;
    color: {{ front.theme.textColor }};
  }
  
  .front .row {
    display: flex;
    width: {{ front.advanced.rowWidth }}%;
  }

  .front .left,
  .front .right {
    flex: 1; /* Each takes up 50% of the width */
    display: flex; /* Use flexbox for centering text */
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center; /* Center text within the section */
  }
  
  .front .top-text-container {
    width: fit-content;
    padding: 0px 5px 0px 5px;
    border-radius: 5px;
    background: {{ front.theme.topTextBg || '#00000000' }};
    font-size: 11px;
    -webkit-text-stroke: 1px {{ front.advanced.topTextStrokeColor || '#00000000' }};
    paint-order: stroke fill;
  }
  
  .front .emphasis {
    color: {{ front.theme.emphasisColor }};
    font-weight: bold;
  }

  .front .step {
    width: 50%;
    margin: auto;
    background: {{ front.theme.stepBg || '#00000000' }};
    border-radius: 5px;
    color: {{ front.theme.stepColor }};
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 16px;
    box-shadow: {{ front.theme.stepBg ? '2px 2px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%)' : 'none' }};
  }

  .front .qr-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1mm;
    margin-top: 1mm;
    margin-bottom: 1mm;
    margin-left: 5mm;
    margin-right: 5mm;
  }

  .front .qr {
    margin-top: 0px;
  }

  .front .qr-code {
    margin: 0.5mm auto 0.5mm auto;
    width: 23mm !important;
    height: 23mm !important;
    padding: 0.5mm;
    background: #fff;
    box-shadow: 2px 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  }

  .front .title {
    width: fit-content;
    margin: auto;
    background: {{ front.theme.stepBg || '#00000000' }};
    border-radius: 5px;
    color: {{ front.theme.stepColor }};
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 16px;
    box-shadow: {{ front.theme.stepBg ? '2px 2px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%)' : 'none' }};
    padding: 0px 10px 0px 10px;
  }
  
  .front .stamp-id {
    position: absolute;
    top: 2mm;
    right: 2mm;
    padding: 2px;
    border-radius: 5px;
    background: {{ front.advanced.stampIdBg }};
    color: {{ front.advanced.stampIdColor || front.theme.textColor }};
    text-align: left;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-family: 'monospace';
  }
  
  .front .redeemable-until {
    margin-top:0.5mm;
    text-align: center;
    letter-spacing: -0.75px;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-family: 'monospace';
    color: {{ front.theme.redeemableUntilColor }};
    background: {{ front.theme.redeemableUntilBg }};
    padding: 1px 7px 1px 7px;
    border-radius: 5px;
  }
  
  /* -----------------------------------------------------
   * BACK CSS
   * -------------------------------------------------- */
  
  .back.stamp-inner {
    background: url({{ back.background }});
    background-size: cover; /* Use 'contain' if you don't want cropping */
    background-position: center; /* Center the image within the container */
    background-repeat: no-repeat; /* Prevent repeating of the background */
    align-items: center;
    color: {{ back.theme.textColor }};
    padding: 2mm;
  }
  
  .back .row {
    width: 90%;
    display: flex;
    gap: 20px; /* Optional: adds spacing between columns */
    margin-bottom: 2mm;
  }
  
  .back .left,
  .back .right {
    flex: auto; /* Each takes up 50% of the width */
    display: flex; /* Use flexbox for centering text */
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
  }
  
  .back .emphasis {
    color: {{ back.theme.emphasisColor }};
    font-weight: bold;
  }
  
  .back .logo {
    width: 100%;
    height: 30px;
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 2mm;
  }
  
  .back .logo img {
    height: 25px;
  }
  
  .back .subtext {
    font-size: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 2mm;
  }
  
  .back .middle-text {
    font-size:15px;
  }
  
  .back .qr-column {
    align-items: flex-end;
    text-align: right;
  }
  
  .back .qr-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1mm;
  }

  .front .qr {
    margin-top: 0px;
  }

  .back .qr-code {
    margin: 0.5mm auto 0.5mm auto;
    width: 18mm !important;
    height: 18mm !important;
    padding: 0.5mm;
    background: #fff;
    box-shadow: 2px 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  }
  
  .back .footer {
    font-size: 9px;
  }
  
  .back .social {
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  
  .back .social img {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    margin-right: 1mm;
  }
  
  {{ advanced.customCSS }}
</style>
